endpointRule: Consume only VERIFIED or explicitly DEGRADED endpoints according to the manifest. Product APIs marked PENDING or UNAVAILABLE are not callable and must surface their exact classification rather than Offline.

tests: Finance security scan over 192 text files
mobile TypeScript/7 tests/manifest verification/Android and iOS Expo bundles
emulator install and 303 ms cold start

recoveryCheckpoint.scope: 115 tracked Finance files restored under apps/finance/** only
recoveryCheckpoint.preservation: The recovery is an isolated provenance-preserving commit. Keep the P0 migration separate from it.

prohibitions: do not build Product Session or device proof
do not create a second DApp SDK
do not hard-code Gateway or RPC
do not put localhost in a release
do not substitute Web success for installed-platform proof
do not classify Product Session failure as whole-app Offline
resumePoint: After EXPLORER_MONITOR_SLICE_CHECKPOINT, resume only Finance release-evidence review or the next required Finance slice; do not start Exchange before Integration resumes the path lock.
